name: no-targets-declared
why: An app whose contract declares no target has an empty queue, and an empty queue is a different answer from a contract that could not be read. This case pins only the first: given no targets, a surface derives nothing rather than inventing a destination. What a surface must NOT do is show this state and one for a missing contract as the same thing, which is a rendering rule rather than a derivation one and belongs to the surface.
